thread:
rhea: Quick thread for design-review: we need a low-friction UX for streaming chat (stop/regenerate, token counter, prompt library overlap). Two protos: compact controls attached to composer vs small inline pill on last message. Thoughts?
omar: Composer-attached controls feel more stable. Inline pill is faster but jumps and can be confusing when the prompt drawer slides in.
lucy: Agreed re stability. Accessibility: if inline appears in a different DOM spot it can break SR reading order. If we do inline, keep a visually-hidden stable element that SR reads instead.
tomas: Token counter: keep it in a predictable place. Right now it lives in the stream overlay and shifts when prompt library opens. Proposal: collapse token into header icon when drawer is open. Use aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true".
viv: Copy: use "Stop" for immediate action. For the regenerate affordance, use "Regenerate response" in menus and "Regenerate" on the pill. Tooltips in sentence case.
olivia: A11y nit (from audit): token badge contrast fails on high-density text. Recommend either a stronger fill (#0057A6) or a 1px outline. Also add reduced-motion support for any token pulse.
omar: Perf: render updates every 200ms, keep exact counter in analytics. Prevent layout shift by reserving a min-width for the badge (calc based on max digits).
lucy: Keyboard UX: Esc stops when streaming; Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R regenerates. If user stops with keyboard, we should briefly focus the Stop control then move focus to the last generated message. Add these to keyboard help.
tomas: Edge-case: opening an external prompt from the library while streaming creates competing overlays. Let's de-duplicate so only one overlay controls stop/regenerate for a given message id.
viv: Design suggestion: small shimmer on partial tokens + static end marker after stop. Works well visually and signals progress. Make sure it respects prefers-reduced-motion.
 rhea: Action items:
- omar -> prototype composer-attached controls + header-collapse token icon (due Mon)
- lucy -> a11y focus + SR reading order spec (due Tue)
- tomas -> de-dupe overlay plan + perf notes (due Tue)
- viv -> microcopy doc + accessibility color options
I'll flag the experiment behind a feature flag and run a short A/B. Drop mocks in #design-review.
rhea: Thanks all, sync at 11am PT tomorrow? :calendar:
